name: Devbox
author: panel@example.com
description: The devbox next to a game server for the panel's VS Code page (docs/features/devboxes.md). Pick it in Admin › Settings › Hosting › Devboxes; the panel makes and runs these servers itself, nobody creates them by hand.

variables.name: Devbox Token
variables.description: The token of this start; the panel sets it at every start.

variables.name: Panel URL
variables.description: Where the devbox reaches the panel; the panel sets it at every start.

variables.name: TLS Certificate
variables.description: The devbox's certificate for VS Code in the browser (base64 PEM); the panel sets it at every start.

variables.name: TLS Key
variables.description: The key of that certificate (base64 PEM); the panel sets it at every start.

variables.name: Edge CA
variables.description: The CA the browser edge's client certificate comes from (base64 PEM); the panel sets it at every start.
